visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a red polo shirt sits at a white table, looking down at a book with a focused expression; she wears a small black lavalier microphone on her collar. (2) Two young boys in matching red and white raglan-style shirts enter the frame from the right, smiling and gesturing with their hands toward the woman. (3) The woman looks up from her book, turning her head toward the boys with an inquisitive facial expression, raising her eyebrows. (4) The boys run away from the camera down a hallway into another room; the camera remains static at the end of the hallway. (5) The boys return down the hallway holding papers; they present them to the woman who examines the papers while pointing at specific sections. (6) The woman points toward the background living area where a couch is visible; the boys start moving around the couch, picking up items and adjusting pillows. (7) One boy sits at an electronic keyboard, pressing keys while looking at the woman; the other boy stands next to her holding a pair of small percussion cymbals. (8) The woman stands in a bright living room, gesturing toward the camera with open palms while smiling; she then holds up her hands in a celebratory gesture. (9) A digital screen interface is shown displaying various cartoon posters and a menu; the woman's face is superimposed in a circular inset occasionally. (10) The two boys sit on a couch, one holding a black remote control and pointing it at the camera; they look surprised and then excited, raising their arms. (11) The woman stands in front of a white wall, pointing her fingers up and sideways while explaining something with an animated facial expression. (12) The woman and the two boys sit together on the couch, laughing and hugging as colorful digital confetti falls across the screen; the woman smiles broadly at the camera.

It highlights specific benefits like Friday Video access, educational cartoons, and online safety management to appeal to parents.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly introduces the FET mobile plan, shows the price, features, and trade-in offers on screen, and provides a clear call to action.
